children: may break support at $100.97 per barrel and fall into a range of $98.22-$98.98.
Support is identified at the 161.8% projection level of wave c from $109.40, serving as one of the wave's endpoints.

However, this wave may not end around $100.97, as a bearish pennant was confirmed, suggesting a target of $97. Immediate resistance is at $102.20, a break above which may lead to a gain into the $102.96-103.43 range.

On the daily chart, the market has fallen below the rising channel and broken support at $102.67. It is expected to fall further into a range of $94.21-$98, as the channel indicates a lower target of $90.43.
The downside may not be limited to $90.43, because the current fall may turn out to be the same degree as the one from the July 23 high of $102.
